sources.title: HABS CA-1942: Ennis House
sources.inspection: Individually inspected measured west elevation and wrought-iron gate drawing. Read all five data pages: two levels, 16-inch buff blocks, north terrace, western motor court, bridge-linked garage/servants wing, lower entrance, teak/glass openings and slight roof parapets.

sources.title: Frank Lloyd Wright Foundation: Ennis House
sources.inspection: Read structural block dimensions, stepped hilltop composition, large retaining platform and Greek-key-derived individual block design. Website ownership/status text is not used as current evidence.

sources.title: Satellite roof context
sources.inspection: Inspected north-up roof: western motor court and narrow garage wing, southwest dining projection, long stepped central/east rooms, north terrace and pool, south retaining platform.

sources.title: Architectural Record, January 1928, pages 56–57
sources.inspection: Read Wright’s description of articulated rooms and individually inspected published floor plan, plot plan and perspective (PDF page 60). Main room/terrace connections guide the model; no original drawing pixels embedded.

sources.title: USGS 3DEP CA_LosAngeles_B23 bare-earth DEM
sources.inspection: Acquired unmodified Float32 elevation tile locked to raster 91959. Source NAVD88, exported at one metre in UTM11N, sampled into a two-metre local review grid. Motor-court datum 255.9812 m; initial sloping-street control replaced before authoring. No flattening or terrain fitting.

scope: House and connected architectural compound; no neighboring houses, vegetation, scaffolding or interiors. No reference-photo pixels embedded.
